title: Eric NDE 4634
content: For some reason when I was age four, I decided to bite an electrical extension cord. What happened after that was totally awesome. The first thing I saw or noticed I was in a void are a huge bubble with black and orange jagged lines, I remember looking all around up, down, all around, and that's all I could see. From that I was yanked from the lines by like a umbilical cord into outer space that pulled me into a huge brain looking center, I would say heaven's emergency room. I remember lying in a room with two hospital beds. I remember a lady, how she looked like us with bigger black eyes. I remember right away she knew I wasn't supposed to be there (this was communicated to me without her saying a word I guess basically mental that I totally understood) and I was sent back in a flash. From that, I woke up and part of my lips were sown together which it still is today. For thirty-one years, this has been as fresh to me as the day it happened. I am sure what I saw was real because at the time I had no real knowledge of religion or any kind of outside influence like that. I don't know how you categorize these experiences but I'm just as sure today as thirty-one years ago that what I saw was real.
